title: Shaking Hands and Racing Hearts
style: Cinematic orchestral pop ballad with intimate female lead vocal, warm strings, soft piano, and subtle woodwinds building into powerful, emotional climaxes. The arrangement starts delicate and sparse, then swells with full orchestra, brass accents, and dynamic percussion. The harmony stays in a bright major key with occasional tense suspensions that resolve, mirroring the feeling of anxiety turning into courage. Moderate tempo around 110 BPM in 4/4, with wide, reverberant space and emotive, lyrical phrasing.
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Oh-oh-oh, oh-oh-oh-oh)
(Oh-oh-oh, oh-oh-oh-oh)
(Oh-oh-oh, oh-oh-oh-oh)
(Oh-oh-oh, oh-oh-oh-oh)

[Verse 1]
Coffee shakes inside my paper cup
Reading every little silence wrong
Heartbeat tripping, it keeps speeding up
Words get tangled, they don’t come out strong
Crowded room and I can’t find my place
Every spotlight feels like it’s on me
Painted smiles, but I can’t hide my face
Every hello feels like a test I’ll see

[Pre-Chorus]
I feel the heat in my cheeks when they’re watching
Hands in my pockets, I’m stalling, I’m stalling

[Chorus]
Shaking hands and racing hearts
All these tiny, tearing parts
Traffic lights and late-night calls
Overthinking every fall
Meeting eyes, I look away
What if I have nеxt to say?
Still I breathe through every fear
All thе little things that make me nervous, I keep here

[Verse 2]
Phone lights up and I just let it ring
Practice answers that I’ll never say
Over dress and question everything
Checking mirrors thirty times a day
First impressions like a fragile glass
One wrong word and it could disappear
Memories of every awkward laugh
Play on loop and echo in my ears

[Pre-Chorus]
I feel the weight of their thoughts when they’re near me
Head full of maybes, they steer me, they steer me

[Chorus]
Shaking hands and racing hearts
All these tiny, tearing parts
Traffic lights and late-night calls
Overthinking every fall
Meeting eyes, I look away
What if I have nеxt to say?
Still I breathe through every fear
All thе little things that make me nervous, I keep here

[Bridge]
Airplane seats and sudden storms
First-day doors and crowded forms
Waiting rooms and open doors
Knocking knees on hardwood floors
Every tremor, every doubt
Teaches me to let it out
I am scared and that’s okay
Still I’m walking in anyway

[Chorus]
Shaking hands and racing hearts
All these tiny, tearing parts
Traffic lights and late-night calls
Overthinking every fall
Meeting eyes, I look away
What if I have next to say?
Still I breathe through every fear
All the little things that make me nervous brought me here

[Outro]
(Oh-oh-oh, oh-oh-oh-oh)
(Oh-oh-oh, oh-oh-oh-oh)
(Oh-oh-oh, oh-oh-oh-oh)
Breathing through the things that make me nervous, I stay near
